messages:
emma (People Ops): Quick idea: host a 'Gratitude Card Swap' during the lunch hour next Thursday. Employees leave a short handwritten note at Station A and pick up a surprise mini-spot envelope at Station B. Low-cost, high-feel. :sparkling_heart:

ryan (People Ops): love the name. How many envelopes/kits? budget?

emma (People Ops): aiming for 60 envelopes (30 spot e-codes $20 + 30 sticker/card packs) + 20 extras. estimated cost ~$900 with vendor + printing. vendor: PaperTrail Gifts.

sasha (HR): policy note: e-cards over $50 trigger reporting. $20 is safe. Also keep card copy neutral, no merits implied.

joe (Finance): need vendor quote + PO. I can auto-approve up to $1000 if paperwork is attached. Tag expense to culture:recognition.

marta (Facilities): delivery ok between 9-10am. I'll reserve the north atrium table for 11:30-1:00 and provide a lockbox for overnight storage.

emma (People Ops): volunteers needed for setup (11:15) and swap staffing (11:30-12:30). 3 volunteers should suffice. Stella, you free?

stella (Volunteer): yes happy to help. i'll bring stamps and a tote.

ryan (People Ops): logistics: we'll have two cardboard stations labeled 'Leave a Note' and 'Pick up a Thank You'. Managers encouraged to hand out a few spot envelopes directly.

sasha (HR): approved card copy: "Thanks for the ways you make work better. A small token from Redwood." Keep it generic.

joe (Finance): once you upload quote, i'll file PO. Also confirm e-code CSV handling: vendor must deliver codes as CSV; we'll map them to recipient emails at issuance to keep audit trail.

emma (People Ops): action items: 1) ryan request final quote, 2) joe file PO when quote attached, 3) marta reserve space & lockbox, 4) sasha confirm copy (done), 5) volunteers sign up in the sheet. events-bot: please set a reminder.

events-bot: Reminder set: "Gratitude Card Swap setup" on 2026-07-09 11:15 (organizer: emma).

emma (People Ops): last q: do we print envelopes with small sticker numbering to track distribution? ryan: yes, let's number 1-80 and have a small ledger. simple and low friction.

stella (Volunteer): i'll maintain the ledger at the pick-up table.

emma (People Ops): perfect. i'll post the signup link and vendor request later today. thanks team :raised_hands:
